snippet.title: Gearbits release date announcement
snippet.description:
Gearbits launches on 10.10.2023! Mark your calendars!

You can wishlist the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506580/Gearbits/

Or get the demo from itch.io https://quackpond-games.itch.io/
